_comment: Reference retrofit devices, recorded as engineering examples — not endorsements and not a shop. Product data changes fast, so every record carries a status. Verified records were cross-checked against a source listed below on the date in `checkedOn`.

en: Clamps over the existing euro cylinder and turns the thumb-turn or a key left in the cylinder
Requires an emergency-function (double-clutch) cylinder if a key is left inside
Optional keypad adds PIN and fingerprint access
AA battery powered; expect 1–3 months between charges depending on use
zh: 夹在现有欧标锁芯上，驱动内侧旋钮或留在锁芯里的钥匙
若内侧留钥匙，锁芯必须为双离合应急功能
可选键盘，提供密码与指纹
使用 AA 电池，视使用情况约 1–3 个月需更换

en: Thumb-turn retrofit that keeps the original cylinder and keys
Matter support; strong retail availability in the UK
Same emergency-function cylinder requirement as any clamp-on motor
zh: 旋钮式改造，保留原锁芯与钥匙
支持 Matter，英国零售渠道覆盖强
与所有夹持式电机相同：锁芯需具备应急功能

en: Adhesive mount on the door face; roughly a five-minute install
Sold with different kits for euro cylinders and for US deadbolts
Adhesive is the weak point on painted, textured or hot doors
Rechargeable, around six months per charge
zh: 背胶贴装在门面，安装约五分钟
分为欧标锁芯与美制插销等不同套件
在喷漆、有纹理或高温的门面上，背胶是薄弱环节
可充电，单次约六个月

en: Replaces the interior thumb-turn rather than clamping over it
Documented compatibility: euro profile, select Scandinavian cylinders, UK oval cylinders, and single-cylinder US deadbolts
Works at both 2-3/8 in (60 mm) and 2-3/4 in (70 mm) backsets on deadbolts
Requires an emergency-function cylinder for euro mortise locks
Matter over Thread; separate IPX5 keypad with fingerprint
zh: 替换内侧旋钮，而不是夹在其上
官方兼容范围：欧标槽型、部分斯堪的纳维亚锁芯、英标椭圆锁芯，以及美制单缸插销
插销上同时支持 2-3/8 英寸（60 mm）与 2-3/4 英寸（70 mm）背距
欧标插芯锁需配应急功能锁芯
Matter over Thread；另配 IPX5 指纹键盘

en: Built around the North American deadbolt thumb-turn; not designed for euro cylinders
The clearest example of why US retrofit products do not transfer to European doors
zh: 围绕北美插销旋钮设计，不适用于欧标锁芯
最清楚地说明了为何美制改造产品无法迁移到欧洲门

en: Clamps over a euro profile cylinder; sold as a set with a compatible high-security cylinder
The compact-body approach: the motor sits close to the door because the cylinder is designed for it
zh: 夹持欧标槽型锁芯，通常与配套的高安全锁芯成套销售
紧凑机身思路：锁芯为电机专门设计，因此电机可贴近门面

en: Replaces the cylinder entirely, so a mechanical key is always retained
Roughly a year of battery life on two CR2 cells — the main advantage of integrating the motor in the cylinder
No drilling, no wiring, no door modification
zh: 整体更换锁芯，因此始终保留机械钥匙
两颗 CR2 电池约一年续航——这是把电机集成进锁芯的主要优势
不打孔、不布线、不改门

devices.name: Push-pull digital lock sets (Asian market category)
devices.vendor: Multiple — Samsung, Kaadas, Philips, Solity, Igloohome, Xiaomi/Aqara and others

en: Recorded as a category, not as specific models, because model availability differs by country and changes yearly
Requires matching the existing mortise footprint: backset, centre distance, faceplate and door thickness
On fire-rated leaves, ask for the doorset Certificate of Conformity, not only a lock certificate
Slim profiles exist specifically for doors that open onto a metal gate
zh: 作为品类而非具体型号记录，因为型号的可得性因国而异且逐年变化
需匹配现有锁孔：背距、中心距、面板与门厚
在耐火门扇上，要索取门组 CoC，而不只是锁的证书
针对面向铁闸的门，市场上有专门的超薄外形
